title: Architecture Sync: Streaming Buffer & Latency Bounds

speaker_segments.text: For real-time meetings, a 5-second buffer is too sluggish for natural conversational interruption. I propose reducing chunk duration to 1.5 seconds.
I disagree with 1.5s chunks for CPU-only nodes because the transcription overhead will cause packet pileups.
Let us table this until Clara runs benchmarks on both CPU and cloud Groq endpoints.

transcript:
[Clara Ruiz]: For real-time meetings, a 5-second buffer is too sluggish for natural conversational interruption. I propose reducing chunk duration to 1.5 seconds.
[Bob Martin]: I disagree with 1.5s chunks for CPU-only nodes because the transcription overhead will cause packet pileups.
[Alice Chen]: Let us table this until Clara runs benchmarks on both CPU and cloud Groq endpoints.
